description: Cited inputs for the electricity-share audit (T10). Every row names a source id from `sources`; every figure in the audit results is read from this file by run_cost_audit.py. Access date for every web source is 2026-10-26 unless a row says otherwise. Evidence strings marked verbatim are exact quotes returned by the fetch; strings marked extract are the fetch tool's summary of the page, not a quote.
fetch_notes: nvidia.com product pages (H100, H200, DGX B200, GB200 NVL72) returned URL_NOT_ON_ALLOWLIST from this session's fetch tool and were not retrieved; NVIDIA datasheets hosted by PNY, HPE, Supermicro, and NVIDIA's images.nvidia.com and docs.nvidia.com were retrieved instead.
eia.gov Electric Power Monthly state tables (5.6.A) could not be read (data is behind spreadsheet links); the Electric Power Annual Table 2.10 (2025 and 2024 by state) was read instead.

sec.gov filings (CoreWeave, Alphabet, Oracle, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon 10-Ks) are reachable but the fetch tool cuts the text before the financial-statement notes, so useful lives were read from company press releases and third-party renderings of the filings; those rows are marked.
nectarclimate.com returned a client error and was not used; PG&E and Dominion tariff figures come from OpenEI's U.S. Utility Rate Database pages.
